armenian_text: Armenian Bible text: Arak29 (arak29.org), Classical Armenian Bible, 1895 Constantinople edition, via the Armenian Bible Society (Yerevan) 1997 reprint of the 1929 American Bible Society (Vienna) reprint. Plain verse text only; Arak29's morphological parsing and English glosses are not reproduced.
english_kjv: English verse text in the chants layer is the King James Version (public domain), taken from the parallel column of the same Arak29 pages and used only to show the verse next to its Armenian.
esv: ESV text is never stored; it loads live through the church's ESV service as before.
about_page_text: Armenian scripture verses on this site come from Arak29 (arak29.org), the Classical Armenian Bible in the 1895 Constantinople edition, as reprinted by the Armenian Bible Society (Yerevan, 1997). Where the Armenian Bible numbers verses differently from the English Bible (for example in the Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Daniel and Joel), the site matches the Armenian text to the English verses it translates, and marks any pairing it could not confirm as needs review. The Jashots transcription remains available as a separate reading layer with a link to the printed page.
status: best-effort draft; uncertain pairings carry status needs_review
